t: 一支英格兰军队在达姆弗里斯和加洛韦的埃斯克河附近击败了一支更大规模的苏格兰部队.
te: An English army defeats a much larger Scottish force near the River Esk in Dumfries and Galloway.
dz: 索尔韦·莫斯战役:一支英格兰军队在达姆弗里斯和加洛韦的埃斯克河附近击败了一支更大规模的苏格兰部队.
de: Battle of Solway Moss: An English army defeats a much larger Scottish force near the River Esk in Dumfries and Galloway.

t: 圣女贞德围攻拉夏里特失败。
te: Joan of Arc unsuccessfully besieges La Charité.
dz: 百年战争：圣女贞德围攻拉夏里特失败。
de: Hundred Years' War: Joan of Arc unsuccessfully besieges La Charité.

t: 塞浦路斯的彼得一世在父亲塞浦路斯的休四世退位后登上塞浦路斯王位.
te: Peter I of Cyprus ascends the throne of Cyprus after his father, Hugh IV of Cyprus, abdicates.
dz: 塞浦路斯的彼得一世在父亲塞浦路斯的休四世退位后登上塞浦路斯王位.
de: Peter I of Cyprus ascends the throne of Cyprus after his father, Hugh IV of Cyprus, abdicates.

t: 格拉尼耶山北侧的一夜间山体滑坡,是欧洲史上记录到的最大的一次历史性的石流故障之一,摧毁了五个村…
te: An overnight landslide on the north side of Mont Granier, one of the largest historical rockslope failures ever recorde…
dz: 格拉尼耶山北侧的一夜间山体滑坡,是欧洲史上记录到的最大的一次历史性的石流故障之一,摧毁了五个村庄.
de: An overnight landslide on the north side of Mont Granier, one of the largest historical rockslope failures ever recorded in Europe, destroys five villages.

t: 在Gąsawa的皮亚斯特公爵集会上,波兰王子莱塞克白族,熊德人亨利公爵等在洗澡时被刺客袭击.
te: At an assembly of Piast dukes at Gąsawa, Polish Prince Leszek the White, Duke Henry the Bearded and others are attacked…
dz: Gąsawa大屠杀:在Gąsawa的皮亚斯特公爵集会上,波兰王子莱塞克白族,熊德人亨利公爵等在洗澡时被刺客袭击.
de: Gąsawa massacre: At an assembly of Piast dukes at Gąsawa, Polish Prince Leszek the White,  Duke Henry the Bearded and others are attacked by assassins while bathing.

t: 成吉思汗在印度河战役中击败了叛逆的克瓦拉兹米亚王子贾拉勒·阿丁,完成了蒙古征服中亚.
te: Genghis Khan defeats the renegade Khwarazmian prince Jalal al-Din at the Battle of the Indus, completing the Mongol con…
dz: 成吉思汗在印度河战役中击败了叛逆的克瓦拉兹米亚王子贾拉勒·阿丁,完成了蒙古征服中亚.
de: Genghis Khan defeats the renegade Khwarazmian prince Jalal al-Din at the Battle of the Indus, completing the Mongol conquest of Central Asia.

t: 蒙费拉特的康拉德与耶路撒冷的伊莎贝拉一世结婚后成为耶路撒冷国王.
te: Conrad of Montferrat becomes King of Jerusalem upon his marriage to Isabella I of Jerusalem.
dz: 蒙费拉特的康拉德与耶路撒冷的伊莎贝拉一世结婚后成为耶路撒冷国王.
de: Conrad of Montferrat becomes King of Jerusalem upon his marriage to Isabella I of Jerusalem.

t: 一场地震袭击了叙利亚,在安提奥克,大马士革和摩苏尔造成多起伤亡和损失.
te: An earthquake hits Syria, causing multiple casualties and damages in Antioch, Damascus and Mosul.
dz: 一场地震袭击了叙利亚,在安提奥克,大马士革和摩苏尔造成多起伤亡和损失.
de: An earthquake hits Syria, causing multiple casualties and damages in Antioch, Damascus and Mosul.

t: 特奥多修斯一世让他的冒险,或正式入会,进入君士坦丁堡.
te: Theodosius I makes his adventus, or formal entry, into Constantinople.
dz: 特奥多修斯一世让他的冒险,或正式入会,进入君士坦丁堡.
de: Theodosius I makes his adventus, or formal entry, into Constantinople.
